summary: Quantum X Labs Inc. filed an 8-K voluntarily providing Item 9.01 disclosures (audited financial statements and unaudited pro forma combined financials) for its acquisition of Quantum X Labs Ltd., which closed on March 4, 2026. No price, premium, or stake terms are restated. The filing is a post-closing financial statement update, not a new deal announcement. The board recommendation and advisor are not named. The deal was completed two months prior, so no regulatory clock or risk-arb angle remains; the filing purely satisfies SEC reporting obligations.
